title: 第九章 君子不立于危墙之下-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》
content:
“小六，把你手机的那些晶核全部都拿出来。”男人对着身后年纪稍小一点的青年说道。

    “是。”说着，青年打开背包露出了里面满满的晶核，少说也有几十枚了。

    见状，爻雪脸上的笑容顿时变得真诚了不少，大客户啊，将这些人身上的晶核全部榨干，游戏商店升级到二级的条件差不多也就完成四分之一的二分之一了。

    之前她看了一眼游戏商店的升级条件，其中晶核需要一百枚，秘境土壤一百吨，秘境中的砂石一百吨，秘境中的树木一百棵。

    除了晶核之外，其余的全部都需要进入秘境中才能够找到，但这么多东西，她一个人不知道要找到猴年马月，所以她准备将这个任务外包给其他人。

    面前的这些人就不错，这才几天啊，竟然就收集了这么多美晶核，说明他们的战斗水平远超其他人。

    将所有的晶核都进行了评估之后，系统很快就给出了一个数字

    4300

    紧接着，一张白色的卡片从机器里面吐了出来。

    “这是身份卡，你们的积分全部都被存在了这里面，想要购买东西可直接使用身份卡中的积分购买，身份卡十分的珍贵，记得不要弄丢了，补办可是需要很多积分的。”

    闻言，男人点了点头，“我再要一间多人宿舍。”

    “没问题。”

    爻雪动作麻利的给这人办理好的房卡。

    她刚刚看了一眼这人身份卡上的名字，他叫苏辰，而除了这个苏辰之外，其余的人都没有想要办身份卡的意思，似乎是默认的将所有的指挥权都交给了苏辰。

    不过无所谓，这跟她没有关系，因为她的任务已经完成了。

    【恭喜宿主完成新手任务，现获得一个0级秘境的使用权，奖励已发放】

    听罢，爻雪环顾四周，结果什么都没有看到，不由的问道：“系统，你说的奖励在什么地方？”

    【秘境入口已经被安置在顶楼】

    今天的任务已经完成了，爻雪直接将店门给关上了，随后他匆匆忙忙来到了顶楼。

    刚来到顶楼，她便发现了系统奖励的秘境。

    在顶楼的正中央，一个两米多高的光门静静的矗立在那儿，光门呈现出淡淡的幽蓝色。

    爻雪走到光门前，有蓝色的光芒照射在她的脸上，莫名的有种阴森的感觉，本来她是想要直接进去的，毕竟之前系统就已经说过了，0级的秘境基本上不会有任何的危险，然而她还是抑制住了自己的这种冲动，面对一个未知的世界，她还是小心一点比较好。

    正所谓，君子不立于危墙之下，就算是要进去，也必须要做好准备才行，她的游戏商店才开了七天，今天更是第一天有客人，升级这事，不着急，不着急，而且，她刚刚不是已经找到了最好的秘境探索者嘛，就让他们去试试水

    打定主意之后，爻雪朝着楼下走去。

    来到一楼之后，就看到苏辰正在楼下，周围只有他一个人，看上去像是在等人。

    在看到爻雪从楼上走下来时，苏辰问道：“这么早就关店，店长刚刚去干什么了？”

content_en:
"Xiao Liu, take out all the crystal cores on your phone." The man said to the slightly younger young man behind him.

"Yes." As he said that, the young man opened his backpack and revealed that it was full of crystal nuclei, at least dozens of them.

Seeing this, the smile on Yaoxue's face suddenly became more sincere. Big customers, if you drain all the crystal cores from these people, the conditions for upgrading the game store to level 2 will be almost one-quarter and one-half.

She took a look at the upgrade conditions in the game store before, which required 100 crystal cores, 100 tons of soil in the secret realm, 100 tons of sand and gravel in the secret realm, and 100 trees in the secret realm.

Except for the crystal core, everything else needs to be found in the secret realm. But with so many things, she doesn’t know how to find them all by herself, so she plans to outsource this task to others.

These people in front of me are pretty good. They have collected so many beautiful crystal cores in just a few days, which shows that their fighting level is far superior to others.

After evaluating all the crystal nuclei, the system quickly gave a number

4300

Immediately afterwards, a white card was spit out from the machine.

"This is the identity card. All your points are stored in it. If you want to buy something, you can directly use the points in the identity card to purchase. The identity card is very precious. Remember not to lose it. Renewal requires a lot of points."

Hearing this, the man nodded, "I want another multi-person dormitory."

"No problem."

Yaoxue quickly applied for the room card for this person.

She just took a look at the name on this person's ID card. His name was Su Chen. Except for this Su Chen, no one else had any intention of getting an ID card. It seemed that they had given all command rights to Su Chen by default.

But it doesn’t matter, it has nothing to do with her, because her mission has been completed.

【Congratulations to the host for completing the novice mission, now you have the right to use a level 0 secret realm, and the reward has been distributed】

After listening, Yaoxue looked around, but saw nothing. She couldn't help but ask: "System, where is the reward you mentioned?"

【The entrance to the secret realm has been placed on the top floor】

Today’s task has been completed, Yaoxue closed the store door directly, and then he hurried to the top floor.

As soon as she arrived on the top floor, she discovered the secret realm of system rewards.

In the center of the top floor, a light door more than two meters high stands quietly there. The light door shows a faint blue color.

Yaoxue walked to the light door, blue light shone on her face, and she had an inexplicable eerie feeling. Originally, she wanted to go in directly. After all, the system had already said before that there was basically no danger in the level 0 secret realm. However, she still suppressed her impulse. Facing an unknown world, it was better for her to be careful.

As the saying goes, a gentleman does not stand under a dangerous wall. Even if he wants to go in, he must be prepared. Her game store has only been open for seven days, and today is the first day there are customers. There is no rush, no hurry about upgrading. Besides, she has just found the best explorer of the secret realm, so let them try the water.

After making up her mind, Yaoxue walked downstairs.

After arriving on the first floor, I saw Su Chen downstairs. He was the only one around. He looked like he was waiting for someone.

When he saw Yao Xue walking down the stairs, Su Chen asked: "The store is closing so early, what did the store manager just do?"
title_en: Chapter 9 A gentleman does not stand under a dangerous wall - "Apocalyptic Invasion: I am an NPC in the dungeon"
